top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises targeted protein degradation as a new chemical modality: a designed molecule converts occupancy-driven pharmacology into event-driven removal of a chosen protein through ubiquitin-ligase recruitment, with a chemically explicit and independently confirmed mechanism (ternary-complex cooperativity, linker and ligand design, the cereblon degron). Crews and Deshaies carry the PROTAC concept and Handa the cereblon mechanism behind approved glue drugs, so one citation about induced proximity can cover both strands honestly. The cost is real (no approved bifunctional degrader, and Ciulli, Sakamoto, Gray, Ito and Kim are omitted), but I judge the science mature enough. P002 is clean and settled but extends the field honoured in 2010, so it ranks second, and an award is preferable to none.
